titles.romaji: Girls und Panzer Movie: Fushou Akiyama Yukari no Sensha Kouza
titles.native: ガールズ&パンツァー 劇場版: 不肖･秋山優花里の戦車講座

description:
Girls und Panzer Movie specials with Yukari Akiyama explaining the background of tank units that appear in the series. Bundled with the Blu-ray and DVD releases of the Girls und Panzer Movie.

Episodes:
- Fushou Akiyama Yukari no Sensha Kouza: Nihon Sensha to Christie no Kodomo-tachi (不肖･秋山優花里の戦車講座 ～日本戦車とクリスティの子供たち～)
- Fushou Akiyama Yukari no Sensha Kouza: Daigaku Senbatsu Team no Sensha-tachi (不肖･秋山優花里の戦車講座 ～大学選抜チームの戦車たち～)
